headline: Haaland's late winner sends Norway into World Cup last 16
summary: Erling Haaland scored an 86th-minute goal to secure a 2-1 victory over Ivory Coast, setting up a high-stakes clash with Brazil.
details: Erling Haaland scored a decisive 86th-minute winner to lead Norway to a 2-1 victory over Ivory Coast at Dallas Stadium. The result ensures Norway's progression to the knockout stages of the World Cup.
caption:
Erling Haaland strikes again! Norway edges Ivory Coast 2-1 to secure a spot in the last 16.

Erling Haaland scored a decisive 86th-minute winner to lead Norway to a 2-1 victory over Ivory Coast at Dallas Stadium. The result ensures Norway's progression to the knockout stages of the World Cup.

headline: PM's order: Post-budget dinner cancelled
summary: The Prime Minister has directed the cancellation of the traditional dinner following the national budget presentation.
details: The Prime Minister of Bangladesh has ordered the cancellation of the post-budget dinner.
This traditional event is typically held after the presentation of the national budget to the parliament.
The decision marks a departure from the usual protocol following the budget announcement.
caption:
